about.title: More About Me
about.description: I am a Software Engineer with over 3 years of expertise in cross-platform mobile application development using Flutter, primarily within the hospitality domain. I engineer high-performance, scalable mobile solutions, collaborating seamlessly with backend teams and adhering to Agile practices and architectural best standards.
